description: WFSim is a Warframe weapon calculator. It builds a loadout, simulates the fight against a named enemy, and searches for the best mods. Every formula cites its source, and every golden test is calibrated against a real in-game run. A board score belongs to its ruler, the named benchmark fight: compare scores only under one ruler, quote the ruler with the number, and give the reader the row's link, which opens the build in the calculator.

tools.name: builder_weapons_find
tools.title: builder.weapons.find
tools.description: Find weapons by name, in any language WFSim speaks.

query.description: name words, in any language WFSim speaks

tools.name: builder_board_read
tools.title: builder.board.read
tools.description: Read a weapon's leaderboard: the measured best builds per ruler (the benchmark fight), mode, and with or without a riven, ranked. Each row carries the link that opens it, and a riven-free row its `build`, which the stats read takes.

weapon.description: weapon id; on the page, the one open when omitted

distinct.description: one row per score; `limit` counts scores

tools.name: builder_stats_read
tools.title: builder.stats.read
tools.description: Read the stats panel for a build: every stat per form and part, base and final, with the mod each change came from, and what the weapon's model does not cover.

build.description: the build: {weapon, mods: [mod ids], arcane: [arcane ids], evolutions: [ids], mode} — a board row's `build` is one; on the page, the one on screen when omitted

tools.name: builder_rivens_read
tools.title: builder.rivens.read
tools.description: The Riven Analyst: each riven the board measured for a weapon, its best score against the #1 riven-free build of the same ruler and mode — what the riven is worth. Only submitted rivens appear.

weapon.description: weapon id; on the page, the one open when omitted

bonuses.description: stat ids each riven has as bonuses

malus.description: the malus: a stat id, "any" or "none"

pooled.description: a ruler's modes as one ranking

tools.name: account_builds_list
tools.title: account.builds.list
tools.description: List the builds saved in the person's WFSim account, each with its `build` (what builder_stats_read takes) and the link that opens it. Needs a key the person claimed: https://wfsim.app/auth.md

tools.name: account_builds_save
tools.title: account.builds.save
tools.description: Save a build to the person's WFSim account, where every browser they sign in on shows it. A new build unless `id` names one to replace. Needs a key the person claimed: https://wfsim.app/auth.md

build.description: the build: {weapon, mods: [mod ids], arcane: [arcane ids], evolutions: [ids], mode} — a board row's `build` is one

name.description: what the person sees it called, at most 24 characters

exilus.description: which of `mods` sits in the exilus slot

id.description: a saved build's id, to replace it
